# UX final current-runtime review: PASS

Reviewed clean frozen commit `5fbebd9df3a60b6c29e09f7236c1b916fe4c4418` on
`android-studio-task/1-reference-runner-membership` with 4,750 Source files.
The current membership module SHA-256 is `80ff948cb850cd291f68afa25411362eb3b996f3fb6f8a5718213f556370e5c5`.
No blocking UX findings remain.

The owner executed ten real CLI cases against the normal current-worktree xtask
build. Creation and exact check succeeded. Existing-output replacement, mismatched
check, wrong revision, unsafe path, wrong length, duplicate identity, input-budget
exhaustion and changed complete source all failed with the expected exit and
specific diagnostic. The case driver checked unchanged output bytes immediately
after check/replacement rejection and preserved the mismatched-check sentinel.
Independent read-only inspection confirms the retained 53,129-byte output hash
`1e55ecb3bbe9273483795d66a349a97043bb870e6cdcf191adc113b09bba7596`, unchanged sentinel, and absence of every negative-case
output. All ten raw-log lengths/hashes and source-bound receipts were reverified.

The actual JSON still reports runtime cases and compiled membership as null,
applicability as unresolved, global census completion as false, new original
behavior credit as zero, and archive re-verification as false. All nineteen runner
facts remain source-only. Literal BUILD syntax completeness never implies runnable
membership. Round-two unsupported producer shapes, filters, multiple catch-alls,
reserved split names and lint-baseline failures remain explicit unresolved evidence.
The documented create/check workflow and scope limits match this behavior.

The normal locked xtask suite passed 136 tests, including all 22 membership tests,
with zero failures, ignored tests or filtered tests. Current-worktree build/test
compiler artifacts have `fresh = false`. The normal strict repository Clippy
command and complete workspace formatting check pass in retained receipts;
optional cargo-shear was unavailable and is not credited. This reviewer ran none
of those commands.

All 4,750 current Source names, byte counts, hashes and modes, raw symlink targets,
complete Git index, full staged/untracked status and empty diffs match every
runtime snapshot. All sixteen original fixtures match their immutable selected
lengths/hashes. Canonical95, the reference manifest and existing census/JUnit4
modules remain byte-identical to task base. Earlier UX reports are preserved.

This verdict covers the verified CLI developer workflow and evidence clarity.
Lead full app, current full workspace CI and final integration remain pending.
It grants no full IDE workflow/UI fidelity, exhaustive census, upstream runtime
membership, performance or original behavior parity credit.

Only these new external review files were written. No reviewer Cargo, compiler,
cache, CLI, SDK, app, source, fixture or Git mutation occurred. Read hold released.
